description.zh: 应用ID。默认取值**app-1000000**。使用说明，请参见[多应用](~~113600~~)。
description.en: The ID of the application. Default value: **app-1000000**. For more information, see [Overview](~~113600~~).

descriptions.zh: > 该接口不会返回每个转码模板组下的转码模板配置信息，您可以通过[查询单个转码模板组](~~102670~~)接口获取。
descriptions.en: > This operation does not return the configurations of transcoding templates in each transcoding template group. To query the configurations of transcoding templates in a specific transcoding template group, call the [GetTranscodeTemplateGroup](~~102670~~) operation.
